SELECT st.table_id AS tableId, st.shop_id AS shopId, st.table_number AS tableNumber, st.status AS status FROM shop_tables st INNER JOIN shops s ON s.shop_id = st.shop_id WHERE st.table_id = #{tableId} AND st.deleted_at IS NULL AND st.is_deleted = FALSE AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.is_deleted = FALSE
AND st.shop_id = #{currentUserShopId}
AND 1 = 0
FOR UPDATE OF st
